title: ProBuilder Move/Rotate/Scale tools

sections.heading: MOVE TOOL
sections.content: The `ProbuilderMoveTool` class inherits from `PositionTool` (which derives from `VertexManipulationTool : EditorTool`) and is decorated with `[EditorTool("ProBuilder Move Tool", typeof(ProBuilderMesh), typeof(PositionToolContext))]`. It applies translation transformations to selected vertices, edges, or faces across one or more `ProBuilderMesh` components. 1. State Fields and Constants: - `k_CardinalAxisError = .001f`: Tolerance threshold for identifying movement aligned with a single cardinal axis. - `k_MinTranslateDeltaSqrMagnitude = .0001f`: Minimum squared delta required before starting an edit session. - `m_Position` (`Vector3`): Current handle position in world space. - `m_RawHandleDelta` (`Vector3`): Translation delta computed as `m_Position - handlePositionOrigin`. - `m_ActiveAxesModel` (`Vector3Mask`): Tracks active translation axes in local model coordinate space. - `m_ActiveAxesWorld` (`Vector3Mask`): Tracks active translation axes in world coordinate space. - `m_SnapAsGroup` (`bool`): Initialized in `OnToolEngaged()` from `EditorSnapping.snapMode == SnapMode.World && EditorSnapping.snapAsGroup`. 2. Tool Engagement and GUI Pipeline (`OnToolEngaged` & `DoToolGUI`): - `OnToolEngaged()`: Initializes `m_ActiveAxesModel` to `Vector3Mask.XYZ` if `EditorSnapping.snapMode == SnapMode.World && !snapAxisConstraint`, otherwise `new Vector3Mask(0x0)`. Caches `m_SnapAsGroup`. - `DoToolGUI()`: When `!isEditing`, initializes `m_Position = m_HandlePosition` where `m_HandlePosition` is retrieved from `MeshSelection.GetHandlePosition()`. - Renders the position handle in SceneView using `m_Position = Handles.PositionHandle(m_Position, m_HandleRotation)`. - Computes `m_RawHandleDelta = m_Position - handlePositionOrigin`. - On handle interaction (`EditorGUI.EndChangeCheck()`): - Checks if `delta.sqrMagnitude > k_MinTranslateDeltaSqrMagnitude * HandleUtility.GetHandleSize(m_Position) || isEditing`. - Calls `BeginEdit("Translate Selection")` on the first movement frame. - If `Tools.vertexDragging` is active (holding the 'V' vertex snap key): - Finds nearest scene vertex via `HandleUtility.FindNearestVertex(currentEvent.mousePosition, null, null, out nearest)`. - Transforms delta to local space: `unrotated = handleRotationOriginInverse * delta`. - Evaluates cardinal alignment `dir = new Vector3Mask(unrotated, k_CardinalAxisError)`. - If single active axis (`dir.active == 1`), projects `nearest` point onto the cardinal ray line using `HandleUtility.ProjectPointLine(nearest, handlePositionOrigin + rotationDirection, handlePositionOrigin - rotationDirection)`. - If not constrained to 1 axis, sets `m_Position = nearest`. - Recomputes `delta = m_Position - handlePositionOrigin`. - Else if `EditorSnapping.snapMode == SnapMode.World`: - If `snapAxisConstraint` is active (`EditorSnapping.snapMethod == SnapAxis.ActiveAxis`): - Accumulates `m_ActiveAxesModel |= new Vector3Mask(handleRotationOriginInverse * delta, k_CardinalAxisError)`. - Converts to world space: `m_ActiveAxesWorld = new Vector3Mask(m_HandleRotation * m_ActiveAxesModel)`. - If `m_ActiveAxesWorld.active == 1`, calculates `m_Position = ProBuilderSnapping.SnapValueOnRay(new Ray(handlePositionOrigin, delta), delta.magnitude, GetSnapValueForAxis(m_ActiveAxesModel), m_ActiveAxesWorld)`. - If multiple axes, calls `m_Position = ProBuilderSnapping.Snap(m_Position, snapValue)`. - Else (all axes snap): `m_Position = ProBuilderSnapping.Snap(m_Position, snapValue)`. - Recomputes `delta = m_Position - handlePositionOrigin`. - Calls `ApplyTranslation(handleRotationOriginInverse * delta)`. - When `showHandleInfo && isEditing`, renders HUD info via `DrawDeltaInfo(string.Format("Translate: {0:F2} {1}", delta.magnitude, (handleRotationOriginInverse * delta).ToString("0.00")))`. 3. Vertex Translation Algorithm (`ApplyTranslation`): - Iterates through each `MeshAndPositions` entry in `elementSelection`. - Retrieves `origins = kvp.positions` (pre-transformation vertex coordinates in world space cached at the start of the edit) and `positions = mesh.positionsInternal`. - For each `ElementGroup` in `kvp.elementGroups`: - Retrieves `postApplyMatrix = GetPostApplyMatrix(group)` and computes `preApplyMatrix = postApplyMatrix.inverse`. - For each vertex `index` in `group.indices`: - If `EditorSnapping.snapMode == SnapMode.World && !m_SnapAsGroup` (individual vertex grid snapping): - If `snapAxisConstraint && m_ActiveAxesWorld.active == 1`: - Evaluates world vertex point `wp = postApplyMatrix.MultiplyPoint3x4(preApplyMatrix.MultiplyPoint3x4(origins[index]))`. - Computes snapped position `snap = ProBuilderSnapping.SnapValueOnRay(new Ray(wp, m_RawHandleDelta), translationMagnitude, GetSnapValueForAxis(m_ActiveAxesWorld), m_ActiveAxesWorld)`. - Assigns `positions[index] = worldToLocal.MultiplyPoint3x4(snap)`. - Else: - Computes `wp = postApplyMatrix.MultiplyPoint3x4(translation + preApplyMatrix.MultiplyPoint3x4(origins[index]))`. - Computes `snap = ProBuilderSnapping.Snap(wp, snapValue)`. - Assigns `positions[index] = worldToLocal.MultiplyPoint3x4(snap)`. - Else (group translation): - Assigns `positions[index] = worldToLocal.MultiplyPoint3x4(postApplyMatrix.MultiplyPoint3x4(translation + preApplyMatrix.MultiplyPoint3x4(origins[index])))`. - Applies updated positions to the underlying Unity mesh `mesh.mesh.vertices = positions`. - Recomputes UVs for modified faces via `mesh.RefreshUV(MeshSelection.selectedFacesInEditZone[mesh])`. - Recomputes vertex normals via `mesh.Refresh(RefreshMask.Normals)`. - Triggers editor repaint via `ProBuilderEditor.Refresh(false)`. 4. Coordinate Space and Gizmo Orientation: - Coordinate spaces are configured via `VertexManipulationTool.handleOrientation`: - `HandleOrientation.World`: Gizmo orientation is `Quaternion.identity`. - `HandleOrientation.ActiveObject`: Gizmo orientation matches `active.mesh.transform.rotation`. - `HandleOrientation.ActiveElement`: Gizmo orientation matches `active.elementGroups.Last().rotation`, which reflects the active face normal and tangent, active edge direction, or active vertex normal.
sections.godot_notes: In Godot, Gizmo translation handles map to EditorNode3DGizmo or EditorPlugin subgizmo manipulation. The distinction between World, Object (Local), and Element coordinates corresponds to Transform3D.basis alignment with Global Basis, Node3D.global_transform.basis, or Face normal/tangent orthonormal basis.

sections.heading: ROTATE TOOL
sections.content:
The `ProbuilderRotateTool` class inherits from `PositionTool` and is registered with `[EditorTool("ProBuilder Rotation Tool", typeof(ProBuilderMesh), typeof(PositionToolContext))]`. It applies 3D rotational deltas to selected elements.

1. Tool GUI Cycle (`DoToolGUI`):
- When `showHandleInfo && isEditing` is true, extracts `euler = m_Rotation.eulerAngles` and displays degrees formatted via `DrawDeltaInfo(string.Format("Rotate: {0,5:##0.00}, {1,5:##0.00}, {2,5:##0.00}", euler.x, euler.y, euler.z))`.
- When `!isEditing`, resets `m_Rotation = Quaternion.identity`.
- Preserves previous handle matrix: `hm = Handles.matrix`.
- Sets current handle matrix: `Handles.matrix = Matrix4x4.TRS(m_HandlePosition, m_HandleRotation, Vector3.one)`.
- Draws rotation gizmo at origin: `m_Rotation = Handles.RotationHandle(m_Rotation, Vector3.zero)`.
- Restores `Handles.matrix = hm`.
- If `EditorGUI.EndChangeCheck()` detects interaction:
  - Calls `BeginEdit("Rotate Selection")` on the first frame of rotation.
  - Invokes `ApplyRotation(m_Rotation)`.

2. Rotation Pivot Calculation (`GetPostApplyMatrix`):
The transformation matrix for an `ElementGroup` is determined by `VertexManipulationTool.pivotPoint`:
- `PivotPoint.Center`: `GetPostApplyMatrix(group)` returns `Matrix4x4.TRS(handlePositionOrigin, handleRotationOrigin, Vector3.one)`. The rotation pivot is the bounding box center of all selected elements (`MeshSelection.bounds.center`). All selected vertices rotate as a single grouped cluster.
- `PivotPoint.ActiveElement`: `GetPostApplyMatrix(group)` returns `Matrix4x4.TRS(handlePositionOrigin, handleRotationOrigin, Vector3.one)`. The rotation pivot is the world position of the active element group (`active.elementGroups.Last().position`). All elements rotate together around this active pivot.
- `PivotPoint.IndividualOrigins`: `GetPostApplyMatrix(group)` returns `Matrix4x4.TRS(group.position, group.rotation, Vector3.one)`. Each `ElementGroup` (individual face, edge group, or vertex cluster) uses its own local position `group.position` and local orientation `group.rotation` as the rotation pivot and coordinate axes. Selected elements rotate independently around their respective individual centers.

3. Vertex Rotation Algorithm (`ApplyRotation`):
- Iterates through each `MeshAndPositions` in `elementSelection`.
- Retrieves `origins = kvp.positions` (world space vertex positions at edit start) and `positions = mesh.positionsInternal`.
- For each `ElementGroup` in `kvp.elementGroups`:
  - `postApplyMatrix = GetPostApplyMatrix(group)`
  - `preApplyMatrix = postApplyMatrix.inverse`
  - Transforms each vertex: `positions[index] = worldToLocal.MultiplyPoint3x4(postApplyMatrix.MultiplyPoint3x4(rotation * preApplyMatrix.MultiplyPoint3x4(origins[index])))`.
- Updates Unity mesh vertices: `mesh.mesh.vertices = positions`.
- Recomputes UVs: `mesh.RefreshUV(MeshSelection.selectedFacesInEditZone[mesh])`.
- Recomputes normals: `mesh.Refresh(RefreshMask.Normals)`.
- Refreshes editor: `ProBuilderEditor.Refresh(false)`.

4. Rotation Handle Appearance per Element Type:
- `SelectMode.Vertex`: Handle is placed at the vertex coordinate or centroid of selected vertices. Orientation aligns with global axes (`World`), mesh transform (`ActiveObject`), or vertex normal (`ActiveElement`).
- `SelectMode.Edge`: Handle is placed at the midpoint of the selected edge. In `ActiveElement`, one axis aligns along the edge vector while another aligns with the shared face normal.
- `SelectMode.Face`: Handle is placed at the face center. In `ActiveElement`, the primary axis aligns with the face normal vector and secondary axes align with the face tangent and bitangent.
sections.godot_notes: Godot equivalent rotation tools apply Basis rotation around a specified pivot Vector3. For IndividualOrigins mode, each selected face or island stores its own centroid and normal Basis, transforming local coordinates by the rotation Basis before re-adding the centroid.

sections.heading: SCALE TOOL
sections.content:
The `ProbuilderScaleTool` class inherits from `PositionTool` and is registered with `[EditorTool("ProBuilder Scale Tool", typeof(ProBuilderMesh), typeof(PositionToolContext))]`. It applies 3D scaling transformations to sub-mesh elements.

1. Tool GUI Cycle (`DoToolGUI`):
- When `showHandleInfo && isEditing` is true, displays the scale readout via `DrawDeltaInfo("Scale: " + m_Scale.ToString("0.00"))`.
- When `!isEditing`, resets `m_Scale = Vector3.one`.
- Obtains handle screen size via `size = HandleUtility.GetHandleSize(m_HandlePosition)`.
- Saves matrix stack `EditorHandleUtility.PushMatrix()`, sets `Handles.matrix = Matrix4x4.TRS(m_HandlePosition, m_HandleRotation, Vector3.one)`.
- Invokes Unity scale gizmo: `m_Scale = Handles.ScaleHandle(m_Scale, Vector3.zero, Quaternion.identity, size)`.
- Restores matrix stack `EditorHandleUtility.PopMatrix()`.
- When `EditorGUI.EndChangeCheck()` detects interaction:
  - Calls `BeginEdit("Scale Selection")` on the initial interaction frame.
  - Passes the scale matrix to `PositionTool.Apply(Matrix4x4.Scale(m_Scale))`.

2. Scale Pivot, Coordinate Axes, and Sub-Mesh Element Scaling (`PositionTool.Apply`):
- Method `PositionTool.Apply(Matrix4x4 delta)` performs the transformation pipeline:
  `positions[index] = worldToLocal.MultiplyPoint3x4(postApplyMatrix.MultiplyPoint3x4(delta.MultiplyPoint3x4(preApplyMatrix.MultiplyPoint3x4(origins[index]))))`
- Behavior across Pivot Modes:
  - In `PivotPoint.Center`: `postApplyMatrix` is `Matrix4x4.TRS(handlePositionOrigin, handleRotationOrigin, Vector3.one)`. Elements scale along the gizmo orientation axes relative to the collective selection centroid.
  - In `PivotPoint.ActiveElement`: Elements scale along the active element's orientation relative to the active element's center.
  - In `PivotPoint.IndividualOrigins`: `postApplyMatrix` is `Matrix4x4.TRS(group.position, group.rotation, Vector3.one)`. The `preApplyMatrix` transforms vertex world positions into each element group's local coordinate frame centered at `group.position`. `Matrix4x4.Scale(m_Scale)` then scales the vertices relative to `Vector3.zero` (the group's centroid). `postApplyMatrix` transforms vertices back to world coordinates. As a result, sub-mesh elements (such as multiple separate selected faces) scale inward or outward around their own individual centers rather than collapsing toward the mesh center.

3. Uniform vs Non-Uniform Scaling:
- Unity's `Handles.ScaleHandle` provides 3 single-axis handles (X, Y, Z), 3 planar dual-axis handles (XY, XZ, YZ), and 1 central uniform scaling cube.
- Non-uniform scaling modifies individual components of `m_Scale` (e.g., `Vector3(2.0, 1.0, 1.0)`). The scale is applied along the local axes defined by `m_HandleRotation` (or `group.rotation` in `IndividualOrigins`).
- Uniform scaling modifies all three axes simultaneously by the same factor (`m_Scale.x == m_Scale.y == m_Scale.z`), preserving element aspect ratios.
sections.godot_notes: Godot implements sub-element scaling by transforming local vertex positions: `v' = center + basis * (scale_vec * (basis.inverse() * (v - center)))`. In IndividualOrigins mode, `center` is each face centroid and `basis` is the face tangent-normal orientation.

sections.heading: SHIFT+MOVE/SCALE
sections.content:
ProBuilder integrates an automatic extrusion and inset shortcut into transformation tools via the Shift modifier key.

1. Exact Trigger and State Tracking:
- In `VertexManipulationTool.cs`, editing state is tracked by the private field `m_IsEditing`.
- When a handle is dragged, `EditorGUI.EndChangeCheck()` detects the change and invokes `BeginEdit(undoMessage)` on the first frame where movement exceeds `k_MinTranslateDeltaSqrMagnitude`.
- Inside `BeginEdit()`:
  - Checks `if (m_IsEditing) return;`.
  - Registers complete object undo for selected meshes: `UndoUtility.RegisterCompleteObjectUndo(selection, undoMessage)`.
  - Dispatches `beforeMeshModification(selection)`.
  - Evaluates Shift modifier: `if (currentEvent.shift) Extrude();`.
  - Sets `m_IsEditing = true`.
- **Crucial Trigger Rule**: The extrusion is triggered ONLY if Shift is held down at the exact instant the drag operation begins (when `BeginEdit` executes on the initial drag frame). Once `m_IsEditing` is set to `true`, pressing, toggling, or releasing Shift during the remainder of the drag has no effect because subsequent frames skip `BeginEdit()`.
- When the mouse button is released (`EventType.MouseUp` or `EventType.Ignore`), `FinishEdit()` resets `m_IsEditing = false`.

2. Extrusion Algorithm (`VertexManipulationTool.Extrude`):
- Uses constant offset `const float epsilon = .00001f` to prevent newly created faces from collapsing into degenerate zero-area triangles during initial mesh validation.
- Evaluates current `ProBuilderEditor.selectMode`:
  - `SelectMode.Face` / `SelectMode.TextureFace`:
    - Checks `mesh.selectedFacesInternal.Length > 0`.
    - Calls `mesh.Extrude(mesh.selectedFacesInternal, s_ExtrudeMethod, epsilon)` where `s_ExtrudeMethod` defaults to `ExtrudeMethod.FaceNormal`.
    - Updates selection to the newly created extruded faces: `mesh.SetSelectedFaces(mesh.selectedFacesInternal)`.
  - `SelectMode.Edge` / `SelectMode.TextureEdge`:
    - If `mesh.selectedFaceCount == 0`, calls `mesh.Extrude(mesh.selectedEdges, epsilon, s_ExtrudeEdgesAsGroup, ProBuilderEditor.s_AllowNonManifoldActions)` where `s_ExtrudeEdgesAsGroup` defaults to `true`.
    - Updates selection to the newly created extruded edges: `mesh.SetSelectedEdges(newEdges)`.
- Executes `mesh.ToMesh()` and `mesh.Refresh()` to update mesh geometry.
- Displays SceneView notification: `EditorUtility.ShowNotification("Extrude")`.
- Calls `ProBuilderEditor.Refresh()`.

3. Extrude-on-Move vs Inset-on-Scale:
- **Shift + Move**: `BeginEdit("Translate Selection")` triggers `Extrude()`, generating new faces separated by `epsilon`. As the user continues dragging the move handle, `ApplyTranslation` pulls the newly extruded faces along the translation delta, forming an extended 3D extrusion.
- **Shift + Scale**: `BeginEdit("Scale Selection")` triggers `Extrude()`, creating zero-thickness extruded faces. As the user drags the scale handle inward in `PivotPoint.IndividualOrigins` (or `PivotPoint.Center`), `PositionTool.Apply(Matrix4x4.Scale(m_Scale))` shrinks the new faces inward toward their centroids, forming a face Inset.
sections.godot_notes: In Godot, Shift+drag transform detection must inspect InputEventMouseMotion or InputEventMouseButton during the input event that initiates dragging. Extrude face/edge algorithms should generate adjacent bridging quads before applying translation/scale deltas.

sections.heading: VERTEX MANIPULATION TOOL BASE
sections.content:
The `VertexManipulationTool` class is the abstract base class extending Unity's `EditorTool`. It coordinates selection state, undo registration, Unity toolbar synchronization, and the mesh rebuild lifecycle across all element transformation tools.

1. Settings and Toolbar Synchronization:
- `s_HandleOrientation` (`Pref<HandleOrientation>("editor.handleOrientation", HandleOrientation.World)`): Tracks gizmo rotation mode.
- `s_PivotPoint` (`Pref<PivotPoint>("editor.pivotPoint", PivotPoint.Center)`): Tracks gizmo position mode.
- `s_PivotModePivotEquivalent` (`Pref<PivotPoint>("editor.pivotModePivotEquivalent", PivotPoint.ActiveElement)`): Configures which ProBuilder pivot point corresponds to Unity's `PivotMode.Pivot` toolbar button.
- `s_ShowHandleSettingsInScene` (`Pref<bool>("developer.showHandleSettingsInScene", false)`): Enables scene view dropdown overlays.
- Synchronization in static constructor:
  - `Tools.pivotRotationChanged += SyncPivotRotation`
  - `Tools.pivotModeChanged += SyncPivotPoint`
  - Maps Unity `Tools.pivotMode == PivotMode.Pivot` to `pivotModePivotEquivalent` (defaults to `PivotPoint.ActiveElement`), and `PivotMode.Center` to `PivotPoint.Center`.
  - Maps Unity `Tools.pivotRotation == PivotRotation.Local` to `HandleOrientation.ActiveObject`, and `PivotRotation.Global` to `HandleOrientation.World`.
  - Supports ProBuilder-specific `HandleOrientation.ActiveElement` without altering Unity's global toolbar state.
  - Changing `handleOrientation` programmatically triggers `MeshSelection.InvalidateCaches()`, `pivotRotationChanged`, toolbar repaint via `UnityEditor.Toolbar.RepaintToolbar`, and `handleOrientationChanged`.

2. Undo Registration and Lightmapping:
- In `BeginEdit(string undoMessage)`:
  - Calls `Lightmapping.PushGIWorkflowMode()` to pause background lightmap baking.
  - Invokes `UndoUtility.RegisterCompleteObjectUndo(selection, undoMessage)` (default message `"Modify Vertices"`).
  - Invokes `beforeMeshModification(selection)` action event.
  - Rebuilds base meshes with `mesh.ToMesh()` and `mesh.Refresh()`.

3. Mesh Refresh Pipeline (During Drag vs On Release):
- **During Drag (Per-Frame Interaction)**:
  - High-performance, low-latency pathway.
  - Updates vertex positions directly in `positionsInternal` and assigns `mesh.mesh.vertices = positions`.
  - Refreshes UV coordinates only for faces in the active edit zone: `mesh.RefreshUV(MeshSelection.selectedFacesInEditZone[mesh])`.
  - Recomputes vertex normals: `mesh.Refresh(RefreshMask.Normals)`.
  - Calls lightweight `ProBuilderEditor.Refresh(false)` without recreating submeshes or regenerating colliders.
- **On Release (`FinishEdit`)**:
  - Invokes `Lightmapping.PopGIWorkflowMode()`.
  - Calls `OnToolDisengaged()`.
  - For every modified mesh in `selection`:
    - `mesh.ToMesh()`: Reconstructs submesh index buffers and triangle topology.
    - `mesh.Refresh()`: Full refresh of normals, tangents, vertex colors, UVs, and mesh bounds.
    - `mesh.Optimize()`: Welds shared vertex attributes, removes unused vertices, and updates mesh collider physics.
  - Calls `ProBuilderEditor.Refresh(false)`.
  - Invokes `afterMeshModification(selection)` action event.
  - Resets `m_IsEditing = false`.
sections.godot_notes: Godot equivalent uses UndoRedo manager creating actions with `add_do_method` and `add_undo_method`. Lightweight per-frame dragging updates ArrayMesh surfaces directly; `FinishEdit` triggers normal recalculation, tangent generation (`ArrayMesh.generate_tangents()`), and collision shape regeneration.

sections.heading: SNAPPING DURING TRANSFORM
sections.content:
ProBuilder provides transform snapping through integration with ProGrids and Unity EditorSnap settings via `EditorSnapping.cs`.

1. Snapping Modes and Priority (`EditorSnapping.snapMode`):
- Evaluates snapping hierarchy:
  1. If `EditorSnapSettings.incrementalSnapActive` is true -> `SnapMode.Relative`
  2. If `ProGridsInterface.SnapEnabled()` is true or (`EditorSnapSettings.gridSnapActive && Tools.pivotRotation == PivotRotation.Global`) -> `SnapMode.World`
  3. Otherwise -> `SnapMode.None`
- `VertexManipulationTool.gridSnapEnabled` returns `Tools.pivotRotation == PivotRotation.Global`.

2. Active Snap Values:
- Move snapping (`activeMoveSnapValue`):
  - `SnapMode.Relative`: returns `EditorSnapSettings.move` (`incrementalSnapMoveValue`).
  - `SnapMode.World`: returns `ProGridsInterface.SnapValue() * Vector3.one` (if ProGrids active) or `GridSettings.size` (`worldSnapMoveValue`).
  - `SnapMode.None`: returns `Vector3.zero`.
- Rotate snapping (`activeRotateSnapValue`):
  - `SnapMode.Relative` or `SnapMode.World`: returns `EditorSnapSettings.rotate` (`incrementalSnapRotateValue` in degrees).
  - `SnapMode.None`: returns `0f`.
- Scale snapping (`activeScaleSnapValue`):
  - `SnapMode.Relative` or `SnapMode.World`: returns `Vector3.one * EditorSnapSettings.scale` (`incrementalSnapScaleValue`).
  - `SnapMode.None`: returns `Vector3.zero`.

3. Move Tool Snapping Pipeline (`ProbuilderMoveTool.cs`):
- Axis snapping constraint (`snapAxisConstraint = EditorSnapping.snapMethod == SnapAxis.ActiveAxis`):
  - When moving a gizmo axis, calculates local mask `m_ActiveAxesModel |= new Vector3Mask(handleRotationOriginInverse * delta, k_CardinalAxisError)`.
  - Calculates world mask `m_ActiveAxesWorld = new Vector3Mask(m_HandleRotation * m_ActiveAxesModel)`.
  - Single active axis (`m_ActiveAxesWorld.active == 1`): Snaps position along the ray using `ProBuilderSnapping.SnapValueOnRay(new Ray(handlePositionOrigin, delta), delta.magnitude, GetSnapValueForAxis(m_ActiveAxesModel), m_ActiveAxesWorld)`.
  - Multi-axis or unconstrained: Snaps all coordinates using `ProBuilderSnapping.Snap(m_Position, snapValue)`.
- Group Snapping vs Individual Vertex Snapping (`m_SnapAsGroup` / `EditorSnapping.snapAsGroup`):
  - When `m_SnapAsGroup` is `true`: The handle position snaps to the grid; all selected vertices move together, maintaining their relative offsets.
  - When `m_SnapAsGroup` is `false` (in `SnapMode.World`): Each vertex in the selection snaps independently to the nearest grid coordinate in world space (`positions[index] = worldToLocal.MultiplyPoint3x4(snap)`).
- Vertex Dragging / Hotkey Snapping (`Tools.vertexDragging`):
  - When holding the 'V' key, `HandleUtility.FindNearestVertex` finds the nearest scene vertex.
  - If dragging along a single cardinal axis (`dir.active == 1`), projects `nearest` onto the cardinal ray line via `HandleUtility.ProjectPointLine`.
  - If unconstrained, sets handle position directly to `nearest`.
sections.godot_notes: In Godot, snapping integrates with EditorInterface.get_editor_settings() or custom grid settings. Snapping algorithms `snapped(val, step)` map directly to ProBuilder's `Mathf.Round(val / step) * step`.

sections.heading: TOOL SETTINGS
sections.content: ProBuilder transformation tools expose configuration options across toolbar overlays, scene view HUD panels, and user preferences. 1. Scene View Overlay Toolbar Elements (`PositionToolEditor` in `PositionTool.cs`): - `PositionToolEditor : Editor, ICreateToolbar` defines overlay elements via `toolbarElements`: - `"Tool Settings/Pivot Mode"`: Toggles between selection bounding center (`PivotMode.Center`) and active element pivot (`PivotMode.Pivot` / `pivotModePivotEquivalent`). - `"ProBuilder Settings/Handle Orientation"`: Selects coordinate space orientation (`HandleOrientation.World`, `HandleOrientation.ActiveObject`, `HandleOrientation.ActiveElement`). - `"ProBuilder Settings/Select Mode"`: Switches element selection mode (`SelectMode.Vertex`, `SelectMode.Edge`, `SelectMode.Face`, `SelectMode.Object`). - `"ProBuilder Settings/Select Back Faces"`: Toggles selection of hidden/occluded back-facing geometry. - `"ProBuilder Settings/Drag Rect Mode"`: Sets box selection intersection behavior (`RectSelectMode.Partial` vs `RectSelectMode.Complete`). 2. Scene View Developer Mode HUD (`VertexManipulationToolSettings.cs`): - In developer mode (when `VertexManipulationTool.showHandleSettingsInScene` / `"developer.showHandleSettingsInScene"` is enabled), `SceneView.duringSceneGui` renders an interactive panel at `Rect(8, view.position.height - 40, 400f, 48f)`: - `Pivot Point`: Enum dropdown for `PivotPoint.Center`, `PivotPoint.ActiveElement`, `PivotPoint.IndividualOrigins`. - `Orientation`: Enum dropdown for `HandleOrientation.World`, `HandleOrientation.ActiveObject`, `HandleOrientation.ActiveElement`. - Modifications trigger `ProBuilderEditor.Refresh()`. 3. Delta Info HUD Display (`PositionTool.DrawDeltaInfo`): - Controlled by user preference `s_ShowHandleInfo` (`Pref("editor.showHandleDelta", false, SettingsScope.User)`). - Renders a floating text box in the bottom-right corner of Scene View using `UI.EditorStyles.sceneTextBox`: - Move Tool: `Translate: {delta.magnitude:F2} {unrotated_delta:0.00}` - Rotate Tool: `Rotate: {euler.x,5:##0.00}, {euler.y,5:##0.00}, {euler.z,5:##0.00}` - Scale Tool: `Scale: {scale_vector:0.00}` 4. Extrusion and Snapping Preferences: - `s_ExtrudeEdgesAsGroup` (`Pref("editor.extrudeEdgesAsGroup", true)`): Controls whether adjacent selected edges extrude as a unified group or separate edges. - `s_ExtrudeMethod` (`Pref("editor.extrudeMethod", ExtrudeMethod.FaceNormal)`): Sets face extrusion direction (`ExtrudeMethod.FaceNormal`, `ExtrudeMethod.VertexNormal`, `ExtrudeMethod.IndividualFaces`). - `s_SnapAsGroup` (`Pref("ProBuilder.SnapSettings.s_SnapAsGroup", true)`): Determines whether elements maintain relative spacing or snap independently. - `s_SnapAxis` (`Pref("ProBuilder.SnapSettings.s_SnapAxis", SnapAxis.ActiveAxis)`): Constrains snapping to the active gizmo axis or all axes.
sections.godot_notes: Godot editor plugins provide tool settings via a custom Control container added to `EditorPlugin.CONTAINER_SPATIAL_EDITOR_MENU` (the 3D viewport top toolbar), including dropdowns for Transform Space (Global/Local), Pivot Mode, and selection filters.

cross_references.relationship: Mesh data structure and Refresh/ToMesh lifecycle methods called by vertex manipulation tools
HandleOrientation, PivotPoint, SelectMode, ExtrudeMethod enums and PreferenceKeys used by tools
ProBuilderSnapping mathematical algorithms (Snap, SnapValueOnRay) and HandleUtility functions
ExtrudeElements algorithms invoked by Shift+Move and Shift+Scale shortcuts
MeshSelection handle position and rotation queries for active element groups

open_questions: The preprocessor directives PROBUILDER_ENABLE_TRANSFORM_ORIGIN_GIZMO and APPLY_POSITION_TO_SPACE_GIZMO are present in ProbuilderMoveTool.cs and PositionTool.cs but are conditionally compiled out in production builds. In a Godot implementation, visual origin gizmos per element group could be enabled as a developer preference.
